shelters.name: Hawaiian Humane Society
shelters.description: Promotes human-animal bond and humane treatment of all animals. Operates Moiliili Campus and Kosasa Family Campus at Hoopili. Offers spay/neuter services and animal home programs.

shelters.name: Oahu SPCA
shelters.description: Founded in 2008, dedicated to rescuing Oahu's homeless pets. Rescues, rehabilitates, and rehomes 15+ dogs and cats weekly, caring for approximately 45 dogs and 75 cats daily.

shelters.name: Hawaii SPCA
shelters.description: Legitimate 501(c)(3) nonprofit animal charity granted status in 2014. Born out of compassion for animals in need on Oahu, serving the Waianae community.

shelters.name: Poi Dogs & Popoki
shelters.description: Volunteer-run foster-based rescue for 16 years, one of the most respected on Oahu. Finds homes for 700-800 cats yearly and performs TNR for 4,000 outdoor cats annually. Name means mixed-breed dogs and cats in Hawaiian.

shelters.name: Hawaii Island Humane Society - Keaau
shelters.description: Established 1965, nonprofit animal welfare organization serving Hawaii Island. Mission to prevent cruelty, eliminate pet overpopulation, and enhance human-animal bond. Began providing county animal control services in the 1970s.

shelters.name: Hawaii Island Humane Society - Kona
shelters.description: Kona Animal Community Center serving West Hawaii. Expanded to include Waimea and Kailua-Kona services in 1990 at county request.

shelters.name: Maui Humane Society
shelters.description: Maui's primary animal welfare organization providing shelter services, adoptions, and community programs including kitten foster program.

shelters.name: Kauai Humane Society
shelters.description: Serving Kauai as the only open-intake animal shelter since 1952. Local independent 501(c)(3) caring for 200-220 animals at Puhi shelter. Performed nearly 3,000 surgeries in 2024.

shelters.name: Kauai SPCA
shelters.description: No-kill, foster and volunteer based animal rescue on the island of Kauai.

shelters.name: Kauai Animal Welfare Society (KAWS)
shelters.description: Dog and cat rescue and sanctuary on Kauai. Volunteers assist residents in helping homeless pets. Building Kauai Cat Haven sanctuary to house hundreds of cats.

shelters.name: KARES - Kohala Animal Relocation and Education Services
shelters.description: Dedicated to rescue of abandoned, abused and stray animals on the Big Island of Hawaii. Rehabilitates and finds foster or adoption homes.

shelters.name: Popoki Place Oahu Cat Sanctuary
shelters.description: Cat sanctuary on Oahu dedicated to providing care for homeless and special needs cats.

shelters.name: Pure Love Animal Sanctuary
shelters.description: No-kill refuge in Waimanalo dedicated to nurturing injured animals and providing them a peaceful, loving home.

shelters.name: Fur-Angel Foundation
shelters.description: Animal welfare organization serving the Honolulu area with rescue and adoption services.

shelters.name: Hawai'i Dog Foundation
shelters.description: No-kill dog rescue organization serving the state of Hawaii.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Hawaii animal shelters and rescue organizations across all major islands. Hawaiian Humane Society is the largest organization on Oahu. Kauai Humane Society (since 1952) is Kauai's only open-intake shelter. Hawaii Island Humane Society (founded 1965) serves the Big Island. Coverage spans Oahu (Honolulu, Kaneohe, Waianae), Big Island (Keaau, Kona, Kohala), Maui (Wailuku), and Kauai (Lihue).
